Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry

Class OrchestEngineTelemetryService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.OrchestEngineTelemetryService
@Component public class OrchestEngineTelemetryService extends Object
Service for reporting engine-side metrics. Tracks resource deployments, process invocations, and worker interactions from the engine's perspective.
